literal: With amiability goodness practiced benefit possessors' character will praise world.
translation: The world celebrates the character of those whose usefulness lies in practicing amiability and goodness.
modern: நயமும் நன்மையும் பொருந்திய செயல்களைச் செய்யும் பயனுடையவர்களின் பண்பினை உலகம் பாராட்டும்.
explanation: The couplet explains that true usefulness in life comes from combining amiability with moral goodness. The word 'nayan' signifies a pleasant, fair, and amiable disposition, while 'nanri' refers to righteous and good deeds. Those who possess the benefit of practicing these two traits are highly valued by society. Consequently, the world praises and celebrates their noble character.
